summary: The fan-out probe failed in the harness: build_node configures nodes 1..5 but the probe created only two instances, so routing to pid 3 panicked before any event. Recorded that as a probe failure, kept the decided-subscription account unchanged, and submitted a successor that builds all five instances with the same ten-entry, trim-to-five, two-cursor fan-out simulation (slow cursor 1, fast cursor 6), predicting the fast stream 10,8,9,10 as evidence that a lagging peer can make another subscriber skip decided entries.
